summary.text: David Lundgren is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Rockingham 16 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 Republican primary.
A chiropractor, he has served in the House since 2010, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: David Lundgren was born in Chelmsford, Massachusetts, and lives in Londonderry, New Hampshire.
He earned a doctor of chiropractic degree from the Palmer College of Chiropractic in 1974 and has worked as a chiropractor at Lundgren Chiropractic.
Ballotpedia lists his House tenure as beginning in 2010, and he was assigned to the State-Federal Relations and Veterans Affairs Committee for the 2019-2020, 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions.
In a 2018 Ballotpedia survey, Lundgren listed opioid abuse and veterans affairs as his top priorities and named healthcare and helping veterans as policy areas he is passionate about.
